name: calendar
guide:
The Google Calendar API v3 (https://developers.google.com/calendar/api/v3/reference), as the person.

```sh
curl -s 'https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/users/me/calendarList'
curl -s "https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events?timeMin=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)&singleEvents=true&orderBy=startTime&maxResults=10"
curl -s -X POST https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/freeBusy -d '{"timeMin":"…","timeMax":"…","items":[{"id":"primary"}]}'
```

Creating or changing an event asks the person first unless they allowed changes:

```sh
curl -s -X POST https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events -d '{"summary":"…","start":{"dateTime":"…"},"end":{"dateTime":"…"}}'
```
